resources.string: Organiza watches which app is open and reads browser address bars, so it can pause you before what you chose to block during a focus session. Nothing leaves your device.
This removes Organiza\'s uninstall protection and is recorded as tampering if a session is running.
Today\'s habits, screen time and next focus block. Tap a circle to mark a habit done.
